data.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
data.description: Chronic autoimmune disease characterized by autoantibody production, immune complex deposition, and multi-organ inflammation affecting ~5 million people worldwide.

data.label: HLA Class II DR Beta 1
data.description: Antigen presentation to CD4+ T cells
data.lupus_evidence: Strongest genetic association with SLE. DRB1*03:01 and *15:01 alleles confer 2-3x increased risk.

data.label: Interferon Regulatory Factor 5
data.description: Transcription factor driving type I IFN and proinflammatory cytokine expression
data.lupus_evidence: Key regulator of the type I interferon signature. Risk haplotype associated with high serum IFN-α activity.

data.label: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 4
data.description: Mediates IL-12 and type I IFN signaling; promotes Th1 and Th17 differentiation
data.lupus_evidence: Risk variant rs7574865 associated with increased STAT4 expression and SLE susceptibility.

data.label: B Lymphoid Tyrosine Kinase
data.description: Src family kinase involved in B cell receptor signaling
data.lupus_evidence: Reduced BLK expression in B cells impairs tolerance checkpoints and promotes autoantibody production.

data.label: TNF Alpha Induced Protein 3 (A20)
data.description: Ubiquitin-editing enzyme that negatively regulates NF-κB signaling
data.lupus_evidence: Loss-of-function variants reduce negative regulation of NF-κB, promoting chronic inflammation.

data.label: Integrin Subunit Alpha M (CD11b)
data.description: Complement receptor 3 (CR3) component; mediates phagocytosis and immune complex clearance
data.lupus_evidence: Missense variants (R77H) impair phagocytosis of apoptotic cells and immune complexes.

data.label: B Cell Scaffold Protein with Ankyrin Repeats 1
data.description: Scaffold protein modulating B cell receptor-induced calcium mobilization
data.lupus_evidence: Associated with SLE through variants affecting B cell hyperresponsiveness.

data.label: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase Non-Receptor Type 22
data.description: Lymphoid tyrosine phosphatase (LYP) that negatively regulates T cell receptor signaling
data.lupus_evidence: R620W gain-of-function variant alters T cell selection thresholds and promotes autoimmunity.

data.label: TNF Superfamily Member 4 (OX40 Ligand)
data.description: Costimulatory molecule enhancing T cell activation and survival
data.lupus_evidence: Upregulated in SLE; promotes T follicular helper responses and autoantibody production.

data.label: Fc Gamma Receptor IIa (CD32a)
data.description: Low-affinity receptor for IgG immune complexes on phagocytes
data.lupus_evidence: H131R polymorphism alters IgG binding affinity and immune complex clearance, increasing lupus nephritis risk.

data.label: Fc Gamma Receptor IIIa (CD16a)
data.description: Low-affinity receptor for IgG; mediates ADCC and immune complex clearance
data.lupus_evidence: V158F polymorphism affects IgG binding and is associated with SLE susceptibility.

data.label: Toll-Like Receptor 7
data.description: Endosomal sensor of single-stranded RNA; drives type I IFN production in plasmacytoid DCs
data.lupus_evidence: Gene duplication and gain-of-function mutations cause lupus in mice and humans. Key driver of the IFN signature.

data.label: Toll-Like Receptor 9
data.description: Endosomal sensor of unmethylated CpG DNA; activates B cells and pDCs
data.lupus_evidence: Recognizes DNA-containing immune complexes; contributes to anti-dsDNA antibody production.

data.label: B Cell Activating Factor (TNFSF13B / BLyS)
data.description: Critical B cell survival and maturation factor
data.lupus_evidence: Elevated serum BAFF levels in SLE patients. Direct therapeutic target of belimumab. Overexpression drives autoantibody production.

data.label: Interferon Alpha and Beta Receptor Subunit 1
data.description: Receptor subunit for type I interferons (IFN-α/β)
data.lupus_evidence: Key mediator of the interferon signature. Therapeutic target of anifrolumab.

data.label: Janus Kinase 1
data.description: Tyrosine kinase mediating signaling for type I/II cytokine receptors
data.lupus_evidence: Required for IFN-α/β, IL-6, and other proinflammatory cytokine signaling. Target of baricitinib and tofacitinib in SLE trials.

data.label: Tyrosine Kinase 2
data.description: Janus kinase mediating type I IFN and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
data.lupus_evidence: Protective loss-of-function variants associated with reduced SLE risk. Selective TYK2 inhibitors in development.

data.label: Bruton Tyrosine Kinase
data.description: Essential kinase for B cell receptor and Fc receptor signaling
data.lupus_evidence: BTK inhibition reduces B cell activation, autoantibody production, and kidney damage in lupus models.

data.label: CD20 (MS4A1 / B-lymphocyte antigen CD20)
data.description: B cell surface protein involved in B cell activation, proliferation, and calcium signaling
data.lupus_evidence: Target of B cell depletion therapies (rituximab, obinutuzumab) used clinically in refractory SLE.

data.label: IMPDH (Inosine Monophosphate Dehydrogenase)
data.description: Rate-limiting enzyme in de novo guanine nucleotide synthesis; essential for lymphocyte proliferation
data.lupus_evidence: Target of mycophenolate mofetil, a first-line therapy for lupus nephritis.

data.label: Calcineurin (PPP3CA / Protein Phosphatase 3)
data.description: Calcium/calmodulin-dependent serine/threonine phosphatase; dephosphorylates NFAT enabling T cell activation
data.lupus_evidence: Target of voclosporin and tacrolimus for lupus nephritis; also stabilizes podocyte actin cytoskeleton in kidney.

data.label: Glucocorticoid Receptor (NR3C1)
data.description: Nuclear receptor that mediates anti-inflammatory effects via transrepression of NF-κB and AP-1, and induction of anti-inflammatory genes
data.lupus_evidence: Target of prednisone and all corticosteroids, the mainstay of acute SLE management. Goal is to minimize exposure due to toxicity.

data.label: Complement C1q A Chain
data.description: Initiates classical complement pathway; opsonizes apoptotic cells for clearance by macrophages
data.lupus_evidence: Homozygous C1q deficiency is the strongest monogenic cause of SLE (>90% penetrance). C1q opsonizes apoptotic debris; deficiency leads to accumulation of self-antigen and loss of tolerance.

data.label: Complement C2
data.description: Component of classical and lectin complement pathways; forms C3 convertase with C4
data.lupus_evidence: C2 deficiency is one of the most common complement deficiencies associated with SLE (~10-20% of homozygous deficient develop SLE). Associated with anti-Ro/SSA antibodies and photosensitivity.

data.label: Complement C4A
data.description: Key component of classical complement pathway; C4A is more efficient at opsonizing immune complexes than C4B
data.lupus_evidence: C4A copy number variation (low gene copy number) is strongly associated with SLE. Low C4A levels impair immune complex clearance and waste disposal. Gene copy number <2 confers ~3-6x risk.

data.label: Interferon Regulatory Factor 7
data.description: Master transcription factor for type I IFN production; activated downstream of TLR7/TLR9-MyD88 signaling in plasmacytoid DCs
data.lupus_evidence: IRF7 risk variants associated with increased IFN-α production and SLE susceptibility. IRF7 is essential for the TLR7/TLR9 → IFN-α axis in pDCs. Gain-of-function variants identified in familial SLE.

data.label: Interleukin-1 Receptor-Associated Kinase 4
data.description: Essential kinase downstream of MyD88 in TLR7/TLR9 and IL-1R signaling; phosphorylates IRF5 and IRF7
data.lupus_evidence: IRAK4 is critical for TLR7/TLR9-driven IFN-α and autoantibody production in lupus models. Pharmacological IRAK4 inhibition reduces disease severity in murine lupus.

data.label: Myeloid Differentiation Primary Response 88
data.description: Universal adaptor protein for TLR7, TLR9, and IL-1 receptor family signaling; recruits IRAK4 and activates IRF5/IRF7
data.lupus_evidence: MyD88 is essential for TLR7/TLR9-mediated B cell activation and autoantibody production. MyD88-deficient lupus-prone mice are protected from disease. A central signaling hub in the lupus IFN pathway.

data.label: IKAROS Family Zinc Finger 1 (IKAROS)
data.description: Lineage-determining transcription factor essential for lymphocyte development; regulates B and T cell differentiation
data.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE across multiple ancestries. IKZF1 variants alter lymphocyte development and promote autoimmunity through dysregulated B and T cell differentiation.

data.label: IKAROS Family Zinc Finger 3 (AIOLOS)
data.description: Transcription factor regulating B cell differentiation, plasma cell development, and autoantibody production
data.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. AIOLOS deficiency in mice leads to lupus-like disease with anti-dsDNA antibodies. Key regulator of plasma cell differentiation and humoral autoimmunity.

data.label: TNFAIP3-Interacting Protein 1 (ABIN-1)
data.description: Ubiquitin-binding protein that cooperates with TNFAIP3 (A20) to negatively regulate NF-κB signaling
data.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. TNIP1 risk variants reduce expression and impair A20-mediated NF-κB suppression. TNIP1-deficient mice develop lupus-like autoimmunity.

data.label: Ubiquitin-Conjugating Enzyme E2 L3 (UBCH7)
data.description: E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme that promotes linear ubiquitination and NF-κB activation; regulates B cell and plasma cell function
data.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE and multiple autoimmune diseases. Risk allele increases UBE2L3 expression in B cells, enhancing NF-κB activation, plasma cell differentiation, and autoantibody production.

data.label: Engulfment and Cell Motility 1
data.description: Involved in cytoskeletal rearrangement, cell migration, and apoptotic cell clearance
data.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated specifically in lupus nephritis. ELMO1 variants associated with increased risk of renal involvement in SLE. Promotes macrophage-mediated clearance of apoptotic cells in the kidney.

data.label: PR/SET Domain 1 (BLIMP-1)
data.description: Master transcription factor driving B cell terminal differentiation into plasma cells and antibody-secreting cells
data.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. PRDM1 risk variants alter Blimp-1 expression in B cells, dysregulating plasma cell differentiation and autoantibody production. Elevated Blimp-1+ plasma cells in SLE.

data.label: Blood Dendritic Cell Antigen 2 (CLEC4C)
data.description: C-type lectin receptor specifically expressed on plasmacytoid dendritic cells; negatively regulates TLR7/TLR9-induced IFN-α production
data.lupus_evidence: BDCA2 is the target of litifilimab (anti-BDCA2 mAb, Phase 3). Binding BDCA2 on pDCs inhibits TLR7/TLR9-mediated IFN-α production, reducing the type I interferon signature at its cellular source.

data.label: B Cell Maturation Antigen (TNFRSF17)
data.description: TNF receptor superfamily member expressed on plasma cells and plasmablasts; critical for long-lived plasma cell survival
data.lupus_evidence: BCMA is the target of teclistamab (BCMAxCD3 bispecific antibody). Depleting BCMA+ long-lived plasma cells may eliminate pathogenic autoantibody-producing cells in lupus. Case reports of drug-free remission after plasma cell depletion in SLE.

data.label: CD19 (B-lymphocyte surface antigen)
data.description: Pan-B-cell surface protein expressed from pre-B through mature B cells and plasmablasts; co-receptor that enhances BCR signaling
data.lupus_evidence: CD19 is the target of anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy. Case series (n=5-8) showed drug-free remission in severe refractory SLE after CD19 CAR-T, with B cell reconstitution of naïve phenotype (Nature Medicine 2022).

data.label: Autophagy Related 5
data.description: Core autophagy protein essential for autophagosome formation; also involved in lymphocyte development and immune regulation
data.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. ATG5 polymorphisms associated with SLE susceptibility. Autophagy dysregulation impairs T and B cell homeostasis, mitochondrial clearance, and promotes type I IFN production.

data.label: Belimumab (Benlysta)
data.description: Binds and neutralizes soluble BAFF, reducing B cell survival and autoantibody production
data.approval: FDA approved 2011 (SLE), 2020 (lupus nephritis)
data.efficacy: SRI-4 response rate ~43-58% at 52 weeks

data.label: Anifrolumab (Saphnelo)
data.description: Blocks type I interferon receptor, suppressing the IFN gene signature
data.approval: FDA approved 2021 (moderate to severe SLE)
data.efficacy: BICLA response rate ~47% vs 30% placebo at 52 weeks (TULIP-2)

data.label: Voclosporin (Lupkynis)
data.description: Calcineurin inhibitor; blocks T cell activation and podocyte stabilization in the kidney
data.approval: FDA approved 2021 (lupus nephritis)
data.efficacy: Complete renal response ~41% vs 23% placebo at 52 weeks (AURORA-1)

data.label: Hydroxychloroquine (Plaquenil)
data.description: Inhibits endosomal acidification, blocking TLR7/9 activation and reducing type I IFN production
data.approval: Standard of care for all SLE patients
data.efficacy: Reduces flares by ~50%, improves survival, reduces thrombosis and organ damage

data.label: Mycophenolate Mofetil (CellCept)
data.description: Inhibits de novo purine synthesis, selectively suppressing lymphocyte proliferation
data.approval: Widely used off-label for lupus nephritis; standard of care
data.efficacy: Comparable to cyclophosphamide for lupus nephritis induction (ALMS trial)

data.label: Cyclophosphamide (Cytoxan)
data.description: Alkylates DNA, causing cell death in rapidly dividing cells including lymphocytes
data.approval: Reserved for severe organ-threatening lupus (nephritis, CNS, pulmonary)
data.efficacy: Gold standard for severe lupus nephritis; limited by toxicity

data.label: Rituximab (Rituxan)
data.description: Depletes CD20+ B cells via ADCC, complement-dependent cytotoxicity, and apoptosis
data.approval: Off-label for refractory SLE (failed RCTs LUNAR and EXPLORER but widely used clinically)
data.efficacy: Used in refractory disease; registry data supports efficacy despite negative RCTs

data.label: Prednisone (Corticosteroids)
data.description: Broad immunosuppression via NF-κB inhibition, reduced cytokine production, and induction of apoptosis in immune cells
data.approval: Mainstay of acute SLE management
data.efficacy: Rapid disease control but significant long-term toxicity; goal is ≤7.5mg/day maintenance

data.label: Tacrolimus (Prograf)
data.description: Calcineurin inhibitor; blocks T cell activation via NFAT inhibition
data.approval: Off-label for lupus nephritis (especially in Asian populations)
data.efficacy: Non-inferior to mycophenolate in some Asian lupus nephritis trials

data.label: Azathioprine (Imuran)
data.description: Inhibits purine synthesis, reducing lymphocyte proliferation
data.approval: Maintenance therapy for lupus nephritis; steroid-sparing agent
data.efficacy: Effective for maintenance after induction; reduces relapse rates

data.label: Baricitinib (Olumiant)
data.description: JAK1/2 inhibitor blocking type I IFN, IL-6, and other cytokine signaling
data.approval: Phase 3 trials in SLE (SLE-BRAVE I & II); mixed results
data.efficacy: Phase 2 positive; Phase 3 SLE-BRAVE-I met primary endpoint, SLE-BRAVE-II did not

data.label: Obinutuzumab (Gazyva)
data.description: Type II anti-CD20 antibody with enhanced B cell depletion vs rituximab
data.approval: Phase 3 in lupus nephritis (REGENCY trial, positive results 2024)
data.efficacy: Superior to placebo for lupus nephritis in REGENCY trial (presented ACR 2024)

data.label: Acalabrutinib (Calquence)
data.description: Highly selective, irreversible second-generation BTK inhibitor with reduced off-target kinase inhibition vs ibrutinib
data.approval: FDA approved 2017 (CLL), 2019 (MCL)
data.efficacy: Improved selectivity profile with reduced cardiovascular and bleeding events vs ibrutinib

data.label: Avacopan (Tavneos)
data.description: Selective C5a receptor antagonist that blocks C5a-mediated neutrophil activation, migration, and adhesion
data.approval: FDA approved 2021 (ANCA-associated vasculitis)
data.efficacy: Superior to prednisone taper for sustained remission in ANCA vasculitis (ADVOCATE trial)

data.label: Cyclosporine (Neoral / Sandimmune)
data.description: Binds cyclophilin and inhibits calcineurin, blocking NFAT dephosphorylation and IL-2 transcription
data.approval: Off-label for lupus nephritis; widely used in transplantation and autoimmune disease
data.efficacy: Effective in lupus nephritis, especially as steroid-sparing agent and in membranous lupus nephritis

data.label: Dimethyl Fumarate (Tecfidera)
data.description: Activates Nrf2 antioxidant pathway and inhibits NF-κB nuclear translocation, reducing proinflammatory cytokine production
data.approval: FDA approved 2013 (multiple sclerosis)
data.efficacy: Reduces relapse rate by ~44-53% in relapsing MS; immunomodulatory effects demonstrated

data.label: Iscalimab (CFZ533 / anti-CD40)
data.description: Blocks CD40-CD40L interaction, preventing T cell-dependent B cell activation and germinal center formation
data.approval: Phase 2 in Sjögren’s syndrome and renal transplantation (investigational)
data.efficacy: Promising Phase 2 results in Sjögren's syndrome; blocks T-B costimulation without platelet effects of anti-CD40L

data.label: Ravulizumab (Ultomiris)
data.description: Long-acting monoclonal antibody that binds C5 and blocks cleavage into C5a and C5b-9 (MAC)
data.approval: FDA approved 2018 (PNH), 2019 (atypical HUS)
data.efficacy: Non-inferior to eculizumab with extended dosing interval (every 8 weeks vs every 2 weeks)

data.label: Rozanolixizumab (Rystiggo)
data.description: Blocks FcRn, reducing IgG recycling and accelerating pathogenic IgG degradation
data.approval: FDA approved 2023 (generalized myasthenia gravis)
data.efficacy: Significant improvement in MG-ADL scores in Phase 3 (MycarinG trial)

data.label: Tofacitinib (Xeljanz)
data.description: Pan-JAK inhibitor (JAK1 > JAK3 > JAK2) that broadly blocks cytokine signaling through JAK-STAT pathways
data.approval: FDA approved 2012 (RA), 2017 (PsA), 2018 (UC)
data.efficacy: Effective across multiple autoimmune diseases; SLE-specific trials not conducted

data.label: Deucravacitinib (Sotyktu)
data.description: Highly selective allosteric TYK2 inhibitor that binds the pseudokinase (JH2) domain, blocking type I IFN, IL-12, and IL-23 signaling without inhibiting JAK1/2/3
data.approval: FDA approved 2022 (plaque psoriasis); Phase 2 in SLE (PAISLEY trial)
data.efficacy: Phase 2 PAISLEY trial in SLE met primary endpoint (SRI-4 response ~58% vs 34% placebo at 32 weeks)

data.label: Dapirolizumab Pegol (Anti-CD40L Fab-PEG)
data.description: PEGylated anti-CD40L Fab fragment that blocks CD40-CD40L interaction, inhibiting T cell-dependent B cell activation without platelet-related thromboembolic events seen with earlier anti-CD40L mAbs
data.approval: Phase 3 in SLE (PHOENYCS GO trial, ongoing)
data.efficacy: Phase 2 showed significant reduction in disease activity; Phase 3 PHOENYCS GO enrolling

data.label: Litifilimab (Anti-BDCA2 / BIIB059)
data.description: Anti-BDCA2 antibody that binds CLEC4C on pDCs, inhibiting TLR7/TLR9-induced IFN-α production and reducing the type I interferon signature at its source
data.approval: Phase 3 in SLE (TOPAZ-1 and TOPAZ-2 trials, ongoing)
data.efficacy: Phase 2 LILAC trial: significant reduction in total active joint count vs placebo in SLE patients with active joint and skin disease

data.label: Iberdomide (CC-220 / Cereblon Modulator)
data.description: Novel cereblon E3 ligase modulator (CELMoD) that promotes ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of Ikaros (IKZF1) and Aiolos (IKZF3), transcription factors essential for plasma cell development and autoantibody production
data.approval: Phase 2 in SLE (positive results); Phase 3 planned
data.efficacy: Phase 2 trial in SLE: significantly higher SRI-4 response rate vs placebo at 24 weeks; reduced anti-dsDNA and increased C3/C4

data.label: Teclistamab (Tecvayli / BCMAxCD3 Bispecific)
data.description: Bispecific antibody that simultaneously binds BCMA on plasma cells and CD3 on T cells, redirecting T cell cytotoxicity to deplete autoantibody-producing plasma cells
data.target: BCMA (TNFRSF17) on plasma cells / CD3 on T cells
data.approval: FDA approved 2022 (multiple myeloma); exploratory for autoimmune disease including SLE
data.efficacy: Deep and durable responses in multiple myeloma; case reports of drug-free remission in refractory SLE using anti-CD19 CAR-T suggest plasma cell depletion approach is promising

data.label: Anti-CD19 CAR-T Cell Therapy
data.description: Autologous T cells engineered with anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that deplete CD19+ B cells including autoreactive clones and plasmablasts. Potential for deep B cell reset and drug-free remission.
data.approval: Investigational for SLE; compassionate use cases reported (Erlangen protocol)
data.route: Single IV infusion after lymphodepleting chemotherapy
data.efficacy: Case series (n=5-8) showed drug-free remission in severe refractory SLE after anti-CD19 CAR-T with B cell reconstitution of naïve phenotype; groundbreaking early results published in Nature Medicine 2022

data.label: Type I Interferon Pathway
data.description: Central pathogenic pathway in SLE. TLR7/TLR9 activation by nucleic acid-containing immune complexes triggers plasmacytoid DCs to produce IFN-α, which signals through IFNAR1/IFNAR2 to activate JAK1/TYK2 → STAT1/STAT2 → IRF9 → ISG transcription.

data.label: B Cell Receptor Signaling & Survival
data.description: B cells are central to SLE pathogenesis. Autoreactive B cells escape tolerance checkpoints due to defective receptor editing and enhanced survival signals. BAFF/BLyS overexpression drives B cell survival. BCR signaling through BTK, BLK, and BANK1 promotes activation.

data.label: JAK-STAT Signaling
data.description: Multiple cytokines implicated in SLE signal through JAK-STAT pathways: type I IFNs (JAK1/TYK2 → STAT1/2), IL-6 (JAK1/JAK2 → STAT3), IL-12/IL-23 (JAK2/TYK2 → STAT4), IL-21 (JAK1/JAK3 → STAT3). STAT4 risk variants enhance IL-12/IFN-α signaling.

data.label: NF-κB Inflammatory Pathway
data.description: NF-κB is a master transcriptional regulator of inflammation. TNFAIP3 (A20) normally limits NF-κB activation through deubiquitination. Loss-of-function TNFAIP3 variants in SLE result in unchecked NF-κB activity, driving proinflammatory cytokine production.

data.label: Complement System & Immune Complex Clearance
data.description: Defective clearance of apoptotic debris and immune complexes is a hallmark of SLE. Complement C1q deficiency is a strong monogenic cause of SLE. FCGR2A and FCGR3A variants impair IgG-mediated clearance. ITGAM (CD11b/CD18) mutations reduce phagocytosis.

data.label: T Cell Costimulation & Follicular Help
data.description: T cells provide help to autoreactive B cells through costimulatory interactions (CD40L-CD40, OX40-OX40L, ICOS-ICOSL). TNFSF4 (OX40L) is upregulated in SLE. T follicular helper (Tfh) cells are expanded in SLE and correlate with autoantibody levels.

data.label: Endosomal TLR Sensing of Nucleic Acids
data.description: TLR7 (ssRNA) and TLR9 (CpG DNA) in endosomes recognize self-nucleic acids in immune complexes. This activates IRF5/IRF7-driven IFN-α production in pDCs and drives B cell activation. TLR7 gene duplication causes human lupus; hydroxychloroquine blocks endosomal TLR activation.

data.label: NETosis & Neutrophil Extracellular Traps
data.description: NETosis is a programmed neutrophil cell death that releases neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) — webs of chromatin and antimicrobial proteins. In SLE, NETosis is dysregulated: NETs persist due to impaired DNase I degradation and serve as a source of autoantigens (dsDNA, histones, LL-37). NETs activate pDCs via TLR7/TLR9 to produce IFN-α and directly damage endothelial and renal tissue in lupus nephritis.

data.label: Complement Cascade (Classical & Terminal)
data.description: The full complement system is central to SLE pathogenesis. C1q, C2, and C4 initiate the classical pathway via immune complex recognition and opsonize apoptotic cells. Their deficiencies (especially C1q and C4A) are the strongest monogenic SLE risk factors. Terminal pathway activation produces C3a/C5a (anaphylatoxins) and C5b-9 (MAC), causing tissue inflammation and damage. Paradoxically, early component deficiencies cause SLE while terminal pathway activation drives tissue injury — creating a therapeutic paradox.

data.label: Autophagy & Cellular Homeostasis
data.description: Autophagy is a conserved cellular degradation pathway that maintains lymphocyte homeostasis, clears damaged mitochondria, and regulates type I IFN production. ATG5 polymorphisms are associated with SLE. Impaired autophagy leads to accumulation of damaged mitochondria and mitochondrial DNA, which activates the cGAS-STING pathway and TLR9, driving IFN production. Autophagy also regulates plasma cell survival and autoantibody secretion.
